title: Oscar and the Terminal
author: S. M. Ravensworth
blurb: Ansel Almeida, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
